review_basis: Exact-hash review of every Japanese-script Shift-JIS run in main that intersects no named text symbol and is not fully contained by a named data symbol; all five regions are binary tables, SDK/runtime support data, or symbol-boundary padding rather than displayed text.

regions.note: Binary TBL_DAMAGE_INIT tail plus alignment padding; the candidate crosses the declared object boundary and is not text storage.
SDK and C runtime support tables between mfdtbl and two_over_pi; Japanese-looking decodes are numeric, address, and table bytes rather than text.
C runtime character-type and locale support data between _ctype_ and lconv; decoded Japanese is incidental binary.
C runtime numeric-format constants and address tables after zeroes.1; Japanese-looking runs are four-byte binary words.
Two-byte tbl_angle value plus NUL padding; the Shift-JIS decode crosses the declared object boundary and is not text storage.
